anti_patterns.name: Generic LLM Wrapper Hype
anti_patterns.description: Calling a 20-line API call to an LLM a 'revolutionary autonomous AI breakthrough'.

anti_patterns.name: Floating Simulation Claims
anti_patterns.description: Showing Gazebo or Isaac Sim robot walking and claiming 'my robot can navigate rough terrain' without clarifying it was in simulation.

anti_patterns.name: Vanity Question Outro
anti_patterns.description: Ending posts with 'What do you think? Agree or disagree?' just to harvest low-quality comments.

anti_patterns.name: Unanchored Multiplier Claims
anti_patterns.description: Claiming '10x performance boost' without specifying the exact hardware, baseline framework, or benchmark suite.
